generator.program.note: The adder's-tongues' own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: a stalk with one sterile blade and a fertile spike above it.

growth.note: Grown to six years, as the built-in ferns are.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

appearance.note: A fleshy, mid-green ovate blade and a buff spike of sporangia, until a genus or species states its own (moonworts' blades are cut).

traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Ophioglossaceae: small terrestrial herbs, a few tropical epiphytes, with fleshy rhizome and stalks; one or a few leaves a year that do not unroll from a crozier, each a fleshy sterile blade, often entire (lobed in Botrychium), and a long-stalked fertile spike or panicle with the sporangia sunk in it, not in sori. A leaf part sterile and part fertile is hemidimorphic here.
